```
import re
import sys
from html.parser import HTMLParser

class SignalInfo(object):
    """保存信号信息"""

    def __init__(self, name, io, wd, dcl):
        self.name = name
        self.io = io
        self.wd = wd
        self.dcl = dcl

    def __repr__(self):
        return "SignalInfo(name=%s, io=%s, wd=%s, dcl=%s)" % (self.name, self.io, self.wd, self.dcl)


def _direction_to_io(direction):
    if direction == 'I':
        return 'input'
    if direction == 'O':
        return 'output'
    return direction


def _extract_range(sig2):
    match = re.search(r'\[([^\]]+)\]', sig2)
    if not match:
        return None
    return '[%s]' % match.group(1)


def _calc_width(range_def):
    if not range_def:
        return None
    content = range_def.strip('[]')
    if ':' in content:
        parts = content.split(':')
        try:
            high = int(parts[0])
            low = int(parts[1])
            return abs(high - low) + 1
        except ValueError:
            return None
    try:
        high = int(content)
        return high + 1
    except ValueError:
        return None


# 方法1: 使用正则表达式
def extract_signals_regex(html):
    """使用正则表达式提取sig1, sig2, direction，并返回SignalInfo字典"""
    pattern = r'<a name="([^"]+)"></a>\s*([^<]+)</p>\s*</td>\s*<td>\s*([^<]+)\s*</td>\s*<td>'
    matches = re.findall(pattern, html, flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
    signal_map = {}
    for sig1, sig2, direction in matches:
        sig1 = sig1.strip()
        sig2 = sig2.strip()
        direction = direction.strip()
        range_def = _extract_range(sig2)
        wd = _calc_width(range_def)
        io = _direction_to_io(direction)
        signal_map[sig1] = SignalInfo(sig1, io, wd, range_def)
    return signal_map

# 方法2: 使用HTMLParser (Python标准库)
class SignalParser(HTMLParser):
    """自定义HTML解析器提取sig1, sig2, direction"""
```

```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Convert HTML files into structured JSON."""

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path


def read_text_with_fallback(path):
    """Read a text file with common encoding fallbacks."""
    encodings = ["utf-8", "utf-8-sig", "gbk", "gb2312", "big5", "latin-1", "cp1252"]
    last_error = None
    for encoding in encodings:
        try:
            return path.read_text(encoding=encoding), encoding
        except UnicodeDecodeError as err:
            last_error = err
    raise UnicodeDecodeError(
        "unknown",
        b"",
        0,
        1,
        "cannot decode file with known encodings: %s" % (last_error or "unknown"),
    )


class HTMLToJSONParser(HTMLParser):
    """Build a JSON-serializable DOM-like tree from HTML content."""

    def __init__(self, include_whitespace=False):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.include_whitespace = include_whitespace
        self.root = {
            "type": "element",
            "tag": "document",
            "attrs": {},
            "children": [],
        }
        self.stack = [self.root]

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        node = {
            "type": "element",
            "tag": tag,
            "attrs": dict(attrs),
            "children": [],
        }
        self.stack[-1]["children"].append(node)
        self.stack.append(node)

    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
        node = {
            "type": "element",
            "tag": tag,
            "attrs": dict(attrs),
            "children": [],
        }
        self.stack[-1]["children"].append(node)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        for idx in range(len(self.stack) - 1, 0, -1):
            if self.stack[idx]["tag"] == tag:
                self.stack = self.stack[:idx]
                break

    def handle_data(self, data):
        text = data if self.include_whitespace else data.strip()
        if not text:
            return
        self.stack[-1]["children"].append({"type": "text", "content": text})

    def handle_comment(self, data):
        self.stack[-1]["children"].append({"type": "comment", "content": data})


def walk_nodes(node):
    """Yield node and all descendants depth-first."""
    yield node
    for child in node.get("children", []):
        if child.get("type") == "element":
            for sub in walk_nodes(child):
                yield sub


def collect_text(node):
    """Collect text from a subtree in document order."""
    pieces = []
    for child in node.get("children", []):
        if child.get("type") == "text":
            pieces.append(child.get("content", ""))
        elif child.get("type") == "element":
            pieces.append(collect_text(child))
    return " ".join(p for p in pieces if p).strip()


def summarize_dom(root):
    """Create lightweight summary useful for analytics."""
    tag_counter = {}
    links = []
    images = []
    forms = []
    tables = []
    title = ""

    for node in walk_nodes(root):
        if node.get("type") != "element":
            continue

        tag = node.get("tag", "")
        tag_counter[tag] = tag_counter.get(tag, 0) + 1
        attrs = node.get("attrs", {})

        if tag == "title" and not title:
            title = collect_text(node)
        elif tag == "a":
            links.append(
                {
                    "text": collect_text(node),
                    "href": attrs.get("href", ""),
                }
            )
        elif tag == "img":
            images.append(
                {
                    "src": attrs.get("src", ""),
                    "alt": attrs.get("alt", ""),
                }
            )
        elif tag == "form":
            forms.append(
                {
                    "action": attrs.get("action", ""),
                    "method": attrs.get("method", "GET").upper(),
                }
            )
        elif tag == "table":
            rows = []
            for sub in walk_nodes(node):
                if sub.get("type") == "element" and sub.get("tag") == "tr":
                    row_cells = []
                    for cell in sub.get("children", []):
                        if cell.get("type") == "element" and cell.get("tag") in {"th", "td"}:
                            row_cells.append(collect_text(cell))
                    if row_cells:
                        rows.append(row_cells)
            tables.append({"rows": rows})

    body_text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", collect_text(root)).strip()
    return {
        "title": title,
        "tag_counts": dict(sorted(tag_counter.items())),
        "links": links,
        "images": images,
        "forms": forms,
        "tables": tables,
        "text_preview": body_text[:500],
    }


def parse_html_to_json(html_text, include_whitespace=False, mode="both"):
    parser = HTMLToJSONParser(include_whitespace=include_whitespace)
    parser.feed(html_text)
    parser.close()

    result = {}
    if mode in {"dom", "both"}:
        result["dom"] = parser.root
    if mode in {"summary", "both"}:
        result["summary"] = summarize_dom(parser.root)
    return result


def main():
    argp = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Analyze HTML and convert it into JSON.",
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
    )
    argp.add_argument("input", help="Input HTML file path")
    argp.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="Output JSON file path (default: input_name.json)")
    argp.add_argument(
        "--mode",
        choices=["dom", "summary", "both"],
        default="both",
        help="Choose JSON payload type",
    )
    argp.add_argument(
        "--include-whitespace",
        action="store_true",
        help="Keep whitespace-only text nodes in DOM output",
    )
    argp.add_argument(
        "--indent",
        type=int,
        default=2,
        help="JSON indentation",
    )
    args = argp.parse_args()

    input_path = Path(args.input)
    if not input_path.exists() or not input_path.is_file():
        print("Error: input file does not exist: %s" % input_path)
        return 1

    output_path = Path(args.output) if args.output else input_path.with_suffix(".json")

    try:
        html_text, encoding = read_text_with_fallback(input_path)
    except Exception as exc:
        print("Error: cannot read input HTML: %s" % exc)
        return 1

    result = parse_html_to_json(
        html_text,
        include_whitespace=args.include_whitespace,
        mode=args.mode,
    )
    result["meta"] = {
        "source": str(input_path),
        "encoding": encoding,
        "mode": args.mode,
    }

    output_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=args.indent),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    print("Done: %s -> %s" % (input_path, output_path))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Convert HTML files into structured JSON."""

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path


def read_text_with_fallback(path):
    """Read a text file with common encoding fallbacks."""
    encodings = ["utf-8-sig", "utf-8", "gbk", "gb2312", "big5", "latin-1", "cp1252"]
    last_error = None
    for encoding in encodings:
        try:
            text = path.read_text(encoding=encoding)
            if text.startswith("\ufeff"):
                text = text[1:]
            return text, encoding
        except UnicodeDecodeError as err:
            last_error = err
    raise UnicodeDecodeError(
        "unknown",
        b"",
        0,
        1,
        "cannot decode file with known encodings: %s" % (last_error or "unknown"),
    )


class HTMLToJSONParser(HTMLParser):
    """Build a JSON-serializable DOM-like tree from HTML content."""

    def __init__(self, include_whitespace=False):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.include_whitespace = include_whitespace
        self.root = {
            "type": "element",
            "tag": "document",
            "attrs": {},
            "children": [],
        }
        self.stack = [self.root]

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        node = {
            "type": "element",
            "tag": tag,
            "attrs": dict(attrs),
            "children": [],
        }
        self.stack[-1]["children"].append(node)
        self.stack.append(node)

    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
        node = {
            "type": "element",
            "tag": tag,
            "attrs": dict(attrs),
            "children": [],
        }
        self.stack[-1]["children"].append(node)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        for idx in range(len(self.stack) - 1, 0, -1):
            if self.stack[idx]["tag"] == tag:
                self.stack = self.stack[:idx]
                break

    def handle_data(self, data):
        text = data if self.include_whitespace else data.strip()
        if not text:
            return
        self.stack[-1]["children"].append({"type": "text", "content": text})

    def handle_comment(self, data):
        self.stack[-1]["children"].append({"type": "comment", "content": data})


def walk_nodes(node):
    """Yield node and all descendants depth-first."""
    yield node
    for child in node.get("children", []):
        if child.get("type") == "element":
            for sub in walk_nodes(child):
                yield sub


def collect_text(node):
    """Collect text from a subtree in document order."""
    pieces = []
    for child in node.get("children", []):
        if child.get("type") == "text":
            pieces.append(child.get("content", ""))
        elif child.get("type") == "element":
            pieces.append(collect_text(child))
    return " ".join(p for p in pieces if p).strip()


def summarize_dom(root):
    """Create lightweight summary useful for analytics."""
    tag_counter = {}
    links = []
    images = []
    forms = []
    tables = []
    title = ""

    for node in walk_nodes(root):
        if node.get("type") != "element":
            continue

        tag = node.get("tag", "")
        tag_counter[tag] = tag_counter.get(tag, 0) + 1
        attrs = node.get("attrs", {})

        if tag == "title" and not title:
            title = collect_text(node)
        elif tag == "a":
            links.append(
                {
                    "text": collect_text(node),
                    "href": attrs.get("href", ""),
                }
            )
        elif tag == "img":
            images.append(
                {
                    "src": attrs.get("src", ""),
                    "alt": attrs.get("alt", ""),
                }
            )
        elif tag == "form":
            forms.append(
                {
                    "action": attrs.get("action", ""),
                    "method": attrs.get("method", "GET").upper(),
                }
            )
        elif tag == "table":
            rows = []
            for sub in walk_nodes(node):
                if sub.get("type") == "element" and sub.get("tag") == "tr":
                    row_cells = []
                    for cell in sub.get("children", []):
                        if cell.get("type") == "element" and cell.get("tag") in {"th", "td"}:
                            row_cells.append(collect_text(cell))
                    if row_cells:
                        rows.append(row_cells)
            tables.append({"rows": rows})

    body_text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", collect_text(root)).strip()
    return {
        "title": title,
        "tag_counts": dict(sorted(tag_counter.items())),
        "links": links,
        "images": images,
        "forms": forms,
        "tables": tables,
        "text_preview": body_text[:500],
    }


def parse_html_to_json(html_text, include_whitespace=False, mode="both"):
    parser = HTMLToJSONParser(include_whitespace=include_whitespace)
    parser.feed(html_text)
    parser.close()

    result = {}
    if mode in {"dom", "both"}:
        result["dom"] = parser.root
    if mode in {"summary", "both"}:
        result["summary"] = summarize_dom(parser.root)
    return result


def main():
    argp = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Analyze HTML and convert it into JSON.",
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
    )
    argp.add_argument("input", help="Input HTML file path")
    argp.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="Output JSON file path (default: input_name.json)")
    argp.add_argument(
        "--mode",
        choices=["dom", "summary", "both"],
        default="both",
        help="Choose JSON payload type",
    )
    argp.add_argument(
        "--include-whitespace",
        action="store_true",
        help="Keep whitespace-only text nodes in DOM output",
    )
    argp.add_argument(
        "--indent",
        type=int,
        default=2,
        help="JSON indentation",
    )
    args = argp.parse_args()

    input_path = Path(args.input)
    if not input_path.exists() or not input_path.is_file():
        print("Error: input file does not exist: %s" % input_path)
        return 1

    output_path = Path(args.output) if args.output else input_path.with_suffix(".json")

    try:
        html_text, encoding = read_text_with_fallback(input_path)
    except Exception as exc:
        print("Error: cannot read input HTML: %s" % exc)
        return 1

    result = parse_html_to_json(
        html_text,
        include_whitespace=args.include_whitespace,
        mode=args.mode,
    )
    result["meta"] = {
        "source": str(input_path),
        "encoding": encoding,
        "mode": args.mode,
    }

    output_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=args.indent),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    print("Done: %s -> %s" % (input_path, output_path))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```
